part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Music
questions: What types of music do you like to listen to? [Why?]
At what times of day do you like to listen to music? [Why?]
Did you learn to play a musical instrument when you were a child? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think all children should learn to play a musical instrument? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe a shop near where you live that you sometimes use.
points: what sorts of product or service it sells
part2.closing: and explain why you use this shop.

topics.title: Local business
questions: What types of local business are there in your neighbourhood? Are there any restaurants, shops or dentists for example?
Do you think local businesses are important for a neighbourhood? In what way?
How do large shopping malls and commercial centres affect small local businesses? Why do you think that is?

topics.title: People and business
questions: Why do some people want to start their own business?
Are there any disadvantages to running a business? Which is the most serious?
What are the most important qualities that a good business person needs? Why is that?
